result.summary: Air5/Qwen provider-prebeta admission subset passed for model identity, coordinator admission, catalog/model evidence, buyer serving smoke, and hardware verifier acceptance. Referral activation, strict-gate variants, and broader payout/billing paths remain outside this artifact.

steps.assertion: Private-prebeta authorization posture is anchored to the committed Entry 172 activation evidence; no SPEC-034 referral promotion is claimed from this artifact.
The provider installed and launched v1.8.61 from signed release assets, preserved a stable redacted provider identity, and ran launchd service live.streamvc.macprovider.
Pearl admitted the same redacted provider identity for the Qwen3-8B model, assigned a coordinator session, preserved heartbeat state, and reported ready/routing-eligible.
The run verified signed catalog and stored recommendation bytes, the selected Qwen3-8B row identity, model hash, weights manifest digest, model-loaded status, and operator-visible installer warnings.
The provider resubmitted hardware evidence, received dual-control hardware trust approval, and the stats hardware verifier exited successfully with the Air5 provider no longer waiting for trust.
Local runtime health, model list, launchd state, encrypted coordinator leg, hash_verified status, coordinator session, and Pearl route eligibility were captured after install.
A buyer smoke request through api.streamvc.live returned HTTP 200 for mlx-community/Qwen3-8B-4bit and Pearl routing selected the same redacted provider as the only matching candidate.
The public artifact omits secrets, LAN addresses, local account names, and operator identity while retaining stable hashes for provider, coordinator session, host, and request correlation.
